subject: general
question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 11 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 3 cm and 6 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell?

( {Use } pi = (22)/(7), { Density } = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}} )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **hollow shell** = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

V = 4/3 × 22/7 × (6³ − 3³) = 4/3 × 22/7 × (216 − 27) = 4/3 × 22/7 × 189

V = 4 × 22 × 9 = 792 cm³

Mass = Volume × Density = 792 × 11 = 8712 g = 8.712 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 8.712 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Internal radius (r) = 3 cm, External radius (R) = 6 cm, Density = 11 g/cm³

**Formula Used:** Volume (V) = 4/3 π(R³ − r³); Mass = Density × Volume

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa6cf975c7bea9be4b6e0583087e0980f44259ca69fb7a1915eb9dd65a069de8.png] 

⇒ Volume of metal = 4/3 × 22/7 × (6³ − 3³)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (216 − 27)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × 189

⇒ Volume = 4 × 22 × 9 = 792 cm³

⇒ Weight in grams = 792 × 11 = 8712 g

⇒ Weight in kg = 8712 ÷ 1000 = 8.712 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 8.712 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a solid sphere is given by V = 4/3 πr³, where r is the radius.

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr². For a hollow shell, the total surface area is 4πR² + 4πr².

Density Conversion

To convert weight from grams to kilograms, divide the value by 1000 (1 kg = 1000 g).</p
